page.overview:
Who is Barbara?

Barbara is the mascot of Daigasso! Band Brothers, the Japan-exclusive predecessor to . She is the arrogant owner of the music shop of Waruwaru Town, GB Music, and helps the player throughout the game. She also made several appearances in Mario-related media, most notably as an Assist Trophy in Super Smash Bros. Brawl.

When Barbara is summoned in a battle via an Assist Trophy, she strums her guitar for a few seconds, releasing sound waves that moderately damages opponents and knocks them back. Her last sound wave is larger and stronger than the other ones.

In addition, a collectible trophy of Barbara can be obtained when it appears at random in the game's single-player modes.

Barbara returns in Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 3DS as a collectible trophy.
